case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Elenca i 10 processi per uso CPU e i 10 per uso
case.goal: Elenca i 10 processi per uso CPU e i 10 per uso memoria in top.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `top.txt`.
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
expected.success_criteria: `top.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
expected.recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.
